description: This file contains an implementation of the SHA-1 hashing algorithm in C, including functions for initialization, updating, and finalizing the hash, along with internal transformation routines.

methods.name: SHA1Transform
methods.description: Performs the core SHA-1 transformation on a 512-bit block.

methods.name: SHA1Init
methods.description: Initializes the SHA-1 context with standard constants.

methods.name: SHA1Update
methods.description: Processes input data and updates the SHA-1 context.

methods.name: SHA1Final
methods.description: Completes the hash computation and outputs the digest.
